newsitem.title: USA: TCI cable unit prelim Q3 revs $1.6 bln.
newsitem.headline: TCI cable unit prelim Q3 revs $1.6 bln.

text.p: Tele-Communications Inc said TCI Communications Inc, which represents its core cable operations, is expected to post revenues of $1.648 billion and operating cash flow of $591 million for the third quarter, according to preliminary figures.

"Overall, the third quarter shows strong revenue growth in TCIC's core cable operations and major progress on its new product introductions," said Brendan Clouston, chief executive of TCI Communications.
The company said earlier that operating cash flow would fall within Wall Street estimates of $575 to $630 million.

The company also put its customer count at 13.947 million. At the end of 1995 the figure was 12.5 million. Results also include two months figures from the recently acquired Viacom systems as well as Primestar by TCI and wireline telephony and digital TV business units.
Based on the preliminary figures, the unit anticipates its third quarter leverage ratio will be 5.99. Leverage ratio is defined as total debt divided by annualized operating cash flow.
It said it was optimistic that leverage "will decline going forward."
It said third quarter expense levels are "temporarily elevated," due primarily to new product start-up costs and the timing of cost efficiencies it expects to realize in the near future.
